name: Los Angeles by Night Notable Locations & Institutions (Lore)

text.content: Following the 1944 Revolt that destroyed Don Sebastian, Jeremy MacNeil declared the founding of the Anarch Free States, a territory that by 1945 stretched from the Mexican border to San Jose and from the Pacific to within fifty miles of Nevada — governed not by a prince but by the Revolutionary Council's founding document, the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.rules-reference.JournalEntry.St7uVm2DqK4nRy8X]{Status} Perfectus. In practice, Los Angeles itself is divided into dozens of gang-held territories called "baronies" (a term Jeremy coined sardonically, recalling his 17th-century Scottish homeland), each ruled by a baron whose authority Jeremy and the other founding anarchs generally decline to challenge so long as the peace holds. Public disputes, grievances, and pronouncements are aired at open assemblies called Rants, where even Jeremy's word can be, and often is, argued with.

Rants are the Free States' substitute for @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} Elysium and formal court — open, often chaotic assemblies where any Kindred may speak, air grievances, propose alliances, or challenge rivals. Unlike a prince's court, no single voice is guaranteed the final word, though Jeremy MacNeil's pronouncements carry enormous informal weight, and known @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} agents like Gloria have used their standing at the Rants to quietly punish those who fail to show them proper attention.

Jeremy MacNeil reserved the San Fernando Valley and central Los Angeles as neutral, baron-free territory defended by his own coterie; the rest of the city was carved up in 1956 into gang territories called baronies after a summit Jeremy called to end escalating turf wars. Notable baronies include Louis Fortier's prosperous West Los Angeles/Beverly Hills domain, Steve Booth's Long Beach, David Geduld's Torrance, Salvador Garcia's East Los Angeles stronghold of El Hermandad, and Mohammed al-Muthlim's secretly @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}-controlled South Central territory ruled through the Crypt's Sons. Boundaries shift constantly through gang warfare, and Los Angeles International Airport is maintained as strictly neutral ground by Jeremy's decree despite lying within Crypt's Sons territory.

pages.name: The Music Center and the Hollywood Elysium Experiment

text.content: Hoping to give the fractious Free States a proper cultural gathering place, Jeremy MacNeil and Louis Fortier privately funded the Music Center — home to the Dorothy Chandler Pavilion, the Ahmanson Theater, and the Mark Taper Forum — after the wider anarch population rejected the idea and forced the pair to build it purely for their own amusement. Most Free States Kindred showed no interest in becoming a classical-arts crowd, choosing instead a Burbank-adjacent Anaheim amusement park (opened the previous year and popular with young Kindred for its night hours) as their real neutral safety zone, maintained by agreement with the local baron ever since.

pages.name: Little Tokyo and the Genji Gaki

text.content: Kindred strictly avoid Los Angeles's Little Tokyo district, whispered to be the domain of an ancient and powerful entity that survives by consuming vampires. The rumor is true: a Gaki of the Genji bloodline has lived there for reasons no Kindred has discovered, served by a small cadre of Koga ninja, and restrained from creating more of her kind only by the district's scarcity of appropriate victims.

vtmlarp.source: Los Angeles by Night, Chapters One, Two & Five
